request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Mudbell Crab".

Creative brief
Name: Mudbell Crab
Collection: Mirebound Court. Swamp creatures serving a drowned marsh court, marked by reeds, lilies, mud, spores, leeches, and deceptive water formations.
Core concept: A rhythmic defender whose shell pulses produce alternating safe gaps.
Body and silhouette: Wide marsh crab with a bell-shaped mud shell, six short legs, and two raised claws.
Signature features: Hanging shell clapper, lily markings, and bubble-covered claws.
Palette and materials: Peat brown, dull bronze, moss green, and muddy yellow.
Movement personality: Side-stepping, ceremonial, and rhythmically repetitive.
Attack concept: Rings its shell three times, producing expanding projectile circles with the safe opening rotating ninety degrees each time.
Directional details: The left claw is capped with a pale snail shell.
Avoid: Metal church bell, ocean-blue crab, visually dense full-circle barrages.
